comparison.objective: Fit compute blades to a work order and blank every unused slot; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Plan interpretation, guided module insertion, and blank installation versus recessed-tool engagement, fine collar rotation, locking, and dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Correct blades and blanks occupy all prescribed slots versus two safe repeated stops with retained setting. PR body, specs, insertion tolerances, and failure rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Rack population and slot completion do not test adjustable damping or response-based commissioning.
